reasons: 01_voice/script.md line 11: 'It answers right away, so they know you saw it.' overstates what the fix does. Quo's feature is an auto-reply ('Automatically respond to texts, missed calls, or voicemails with pre-defined messages'): it goes out before the owner has seen anything, and our own example text ('Sorry I missed you, I'm on a job. I'll call you back inside the hour.') never says the owner saw the call. No source backs 'they know you saw it'; the honest version is what the text actually tells the caller. Exact fix: 'It answers right away, so they know you'll call back.' (same 6 words after the comma, 79 words total unchanged; still sets up line 13's 'call missed calls back inside the hour').

05_render/captions.json instagram.caption, tiktok.caption, facebook.caption (This week step 2): 'The text answers right away so they know you saw it; your callback books the job.' Same overstatement. Exact fix on all three: 'The text answers right away so they know you'll call back; your callback is what books the job.' (youtube.description step 2 does not carry the phrase; no change there.)

01_voice/brief.md line 17 (Mechanism S1) 'so they know you saw the call', line 24 (Shape) 'so they know you saw it', line 70 (Claims table) 'so they know you saw it': change each to 'so they know you'll call back' so the claims table quotes the script as said after the fix.
